text: The sessions compatibility patch adds the name to OptionalPermission and logs a warning before set/get/removeTabValue when it is missing. All three methods continue to the existing operation, including in fixed accepted source. The test change only adds the requested permission to a normal set/get/remove scenario; it does not test omission or warning text. Future enforcement and developer outreach in discussion are not implemented by this patch. No test or extension ran.
title: Recognizing sessions permission did not yet make it mandatory
